title: Question Mark Is a Quantifier
text: In regex, ? does not automatically mean a literal question mark. It makes the previous token optional, meaning it appears zero or one time.

title: Literal Question Mark
text: Which escape sequence would match a literal question mark?

title: Apply 2023?
text: The pattern r"2023?" means $$202$$ followed by zero or one $$3$$. In the string, it matches $$2023$$, but it does not include the literal question mark after $$2023$$.
